dataset: TNI Historical U.S. Equity / S&P 500 Return Methods

methodology_periods.description: Robert Shiller/Yale historical U.S. equity-market observations. TNI reconstructs annual price and dividend-reinvested returns from monthly observations. This period is not represented as the modern S&P 500.
TNI conventional annual price returns combined with Aswath Damodaran/NYU Stern dividend-inclusive large-cap/S&P returns.
Yahoo Finance S&P 500 Price Index (^GSPC), S&P 500 Total Return Index (^SP500TR), and BLS CPI-U via FRED.
